candidates.change_summary: Change return value from true to false
Change return value to the negation of the length check (return _tos.length == 0;)

Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) guard with require(_tos.length >= 0), which always passes and changes behavior only for empty _tos arrays, where the original reverts and the mutant returns true without making any calls.

Replace the transferFrom selector hash string with another valid selector string, making caddress.call execute a different function on caddress and thereby changing the observable success/failure and return behavior.
Change the loop initialization from i = 0 to i = 1, skipping the first token transfer and reducing the number of external calls, which changes observable behavior for non-empty _tos arrays.

Change the loop condition from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert for all non-empty _tos arrays, which differs from the original observable success behavior.
Change the loop increment from i++ to i += 2, skipping every other token transfer and changing observable behavior for _tos arrays with length greater than one.
Change the calldata argument for the amount from v[i] to v[0], causing the same amount to be used for every transfer and changing observable behavior when _tos.length > 1 or i > 0.
Change the calldata recipient argument from _tos[i] to _tos[0], sending every transfer to the first recipient and changing observable behavior when _tos has more than one element.

Change the revert-on-failed-call condition from !_s to _s, so the function reverts when the external call succeeds and continues when it fails, inverting observable behavior for calls whose external call can fail.
Replace the external call destination caddress with from, causing the call to target the sender address instead and changing observable behavior when caddress and from differ.
Replace the return value true with false, changing the function's observable return value to false for every successful call.
